message: Two authorized cross-target trace-config returns are now available: CROSS_SOURCE_MULTI_ANCHOR was structurally clean but produced no strict downstream gain on #78, while TITLE_ANCHORED produced a strict returned query-relevance gain on independently selected #169. Consume both through learner-owned returned utility. Form the next developmental problem and target from the fresh repository field with no mentor target tie-break. If a relation-trace candidate is independently reached, let the learner's exploration/exploitation rule choose among expressible configs, freeze before fresh return, run B1 before B2, preserve the lexical comparator, and retain only returned downstream gain. Do not treat one positive config result as universal; cross-target transfer is the discriminator. WITHHOLD remains correct when no strict gain is returned.
purpose: Test cross-target generalization of returned trace-config utility across a third learner-selected problem without mentor target binding or hand-selected config.
